title: Claude Fable 5 Suspended!
description:
Anthropic Fable 5 has been suspended by the US government over national security concerns. The latest Claude model has been deemed too dangerous to allow the rest of the world to have access to. 

Here's your super quick briefing on the facts.

top_comments.author: @arnettbuckers
top_comments.text: Sovereign edge AI is only feasible when we can run sophisticated SOTA AI models. That requires powerful and energy efficient 1nm/sub-1nm chips which aren't widely available in consumer devices... yet. Current guesstimates show we're at best 5 years away from that.

top_comments.author: @magicdeaths
top_comments.text: Trump playing favourites, selectively applies the rules, Anthropic refused to sign Pentagon contract and now this is the result.

top_comments.author: @folklorefanatic7193
top_comments.text: Opus 4.8 was worse than 4.6 for a lot of creative tasks, and they nerfed 4.6. Please don't mislead your audience by saying 4.8 "can do pretty much anything you need it to do." The difference between 4.8 and Fable 5 is the difference between endless rounds of code error corrections and having an experienced dev at your side.
